_doc: Explicitly approved redirects. A URL emitted by the homepage, a sitemap, the nav registry or the city selector may resolve to a redirect ONLY if it matches one of these patterns. Anything else must be a canonical 200. Patterns are JS regexes matched against the emitted path.

approved.reason: Course URLs are a documented permanent nginx redirect to their academy page (see src/routes/sitemap-pages-courses[.]xml.ts). Destinations are NOT derivable from the slug, so internal links are left pointing at the redirect rather than guessed.
Marketplace listing-creation entry point (WEST). The draft URL is the published CTA target and 302s to the wizard.
Auth-gated: unauthenticated visitors are 307'd to the public program page. Must not be rewritten.
Legacy help-centre URLs kept alive for Search Console recovery (src/routes/legal-and-compliance.$.ts).
Legacy splat routes that resolve legacy slugs to their current page.
